scope: E011 supplement to the archived 50-card library; formulas are working definitions, not a claim to all worldwide formulas.

cards.role: Reference-consistency statistic after PN removal; invariant to one nonzero common complex gain
cards.verification: Synthetic gain/phase invariance and E010 scalar resource agreement pass; E011 reports all threshold failures
cards.limit: Channel phase within a window, slot edges and reference-like payload alter detectability; this is not cyclic spectral coherence

cards.verification: Current implementation exhaustively evaluates one split through cumulative sums; known step/constant synthetic tests pass
cards.limit: A forced optimum exists even under no change; reported contrast/SSE admission and minimum length remain necessary

cards.verification: Frozen map tested on real decoded fields; E011 compares predicted lengths with header-blind signal estimates
cards.limit: Nc and b are separate inherited hypotheses; code68 uses a symbol unit only. Endpoints do not determine unknown parity matrices.

cards.formula: y=A*u; unit nullity = columns(A)-rank(A); minimize t subject to -t <= A*u-y <= t and u>=1
cards.source: E011 algebraic diagnostic; current NumPy least squares and SciPy HiGHS linear programming
cards.verification: Synthetic counterexample verifies that a negative minimum-norm unit does not exclude positive solutions; both layouts admit positive examples on current endpoints
cards.limit: This is same-data fitting, not a held-out prediction; bounds and unknown units are model assumptions

cards.source: E010 retained H1 bits evaluated under conditional 19/20-bit parsing
cards.verification: All 18 first headers have doubled 19-bit quantities; halving resource units preserves the H2 location
cards.limit: Shows a count/unit ambiguity; it neither proves the 19-bit model nor uniquely specifies the full field widths
